titulo: «Too Soon»: Somebody Measured Exactly How Long You Have to Wait
descripcion: What turns a misfortune into a joke isn't time — it's psychological distance, and it moves on four axes. This episode covers why a severe misfortune needs distance while a mild one is ruined by too much of it, what researchers found when they tracked humor about Hurricane Sandy day by day for months, and how to turn the dial when the bad day is yours. It ends with the uncomfortable part: your distance is not your listener's, and that isn't hypocrisy.
